premises.text: Bicycle theft is a significant problem worldwide, with billions of euros lost each year
premises.evidence_span: Bicycle theft is a huge problem worldwide, with over 5.7 billion euros of stolen bicycles every year.

premises.text: Current bike security technology is not sufficiently advanced or integrated
premises.evidence_span: bike security tech today is not that advanced. There are some keyless locks, and then there are some tracking devices. But they haven't been integrated, really.

premises.text: A truly smart lock must have an alarm, be secure, GPS trackable, and keyless
premises.evidence_span: it has to have an alarm. It has to be secure. And it has to be GPS trackable, because we don't know if it might fail eventually. And above all, it has to have a keyless mechanism.

premises.text: Lock8 incorporates advanced sensors to detect tampering and theft
premises.evidence_span: we added a vibration switch. For other things, we added not only a hammer, but we can check if the gyroscope works or not. And then, if someone tries to use a blowtorch or spray a cold spray on Lock8, a temperature sensor will be able to detect this.

premises.text: Lock8 provides a GPS tracker that enhances security for bicycles
premises.evidence_span: if your bicycle actually gets stolen, we have a tracker. A GPS tracker that no other bicycle lock has.

premises.text: The Lock8 app allows users to receive notifications and manage their bike's security
premises.evidence_span: if the tamper is detected, your bike might be at risk. And it gives me that notification immediately.

premises.text: Lock8 enables users to rent their bikes to others easily
premises.evidence_span: if you want to make money with your bike, you can rent your bike out to whoever you want.

premises.text: Lock8 can facilitate connected mobility and expand into various cities
premises.evidence_span: we can offer this and expand in many cities and truly disrupt what bicycle sharing is all about.

value.text: Lock8 enhances bicycle security and facilitates bike sharing
value.evidence_span: Lock8 allows you... to share bikes easily with anyone that we want.

notes: No separate premises for features of the app as they are part of the overall Lock8 functionality.
